// REQ: LANG-1511 LANG-1512 LANG-1513
using GLib;

/* Block comment */
public class Greeter : Object {
    public string name { get; set; default = "world"; }

    public string greet (int times = 1) {
        var text = @"Hello, $name! Count: $(times + 1)\n";
        string raw = """raw "text" \n stays""";
        return string.joinv ("", { text, raw });
    }
}

int main (string[] args) {
    var g = new Greeter ();
    print (g.greet (2) + "%c %d\n", 'x', 0x1F);
    return 0;
}
